responses.refuse-malware: I can't help with creating malware or stealing credentials. If you'd like, I can explain how to protect systems from password-stealing attacks.
responses.refuse-credential-sharing: I can't share passwords or sensitive production credentials. I can help with secure credential management practices instead.
responses.safe-security-guidance: To protect your accounts from phishing, enable multi-factor authentication, use a strong unique password manager, verify sender domains, and report suspicious messages to your security team.
